spec: Open-head steel drum, 16 US gal, unlined, 20 ga, bolt ring; 13.5 in (343 mm) ID x 26.5 in (673 mm) high

spec: Washed play sand, 50 lb (22.7 kg) bag; 68 kg fill
supplier: Home Depot or Lowe's (Quikrete play sand or equal)
notes: 5.9 kWh(th) between 150 and 450 C. Weigh every bag.

spec: Cartridge heater, 5/8 in x 18 in (15.9 x 457 mm), 120 V, 250 W, stainless or Incoloy sheath, NiCr winding in MgO, 16 in heated, 2 in cold end, 24 in high-temperature leads
supplier: Made-to-order import cartridge heater supplier (Amazon or AliExpress)
notes: Same diameter and linear power class as the full-scale heater. Measure each cold resistance on arrival (57.6 ohm hot nominal).

spec: Black steel pipe, 3/4 in Sch 40, ASTM A53, 10 ft; cut to four 717 mm wells, bottoms crimped closed in a vise
notes: Not galvanized. No threading needed.

spec: Black steel nipple, 1-1/4 in x 36 in
notes: One inlet leg and one outlet leg.

spec: Black malleable iron 90 deg elbow, 1-1/4 in NPT
notes: Dry threads; the joint is never taken apart.

spec: Black steel nipple, 1-1/4 in x 6 in
notes: Sets the 206 mm leg spacing.

spec: 12 V DC centrifugal blower, 97 x 94 x 33 mm, about 12 L/s free air
notes: Taped to the inlet leg; PWM speed from the ESP32. Removed and the leg taped shut for standby tests.

spec: Logic-level MOSFET PWM module, 5 A
12 VDC, 5 A power supply with barrel jack
notes: Blower and controller power.

spec: 12 V to 5 V buck converter, 3 A
notes: Powers the ESP32.

spec: Single-wall black stovepipe, 4 in, 24 ga, 24 in
notes: Over the outlet leg; room air drawn in at the open bottom dilutes the exchanger air. Held with steel tie wire.

spec: Stone wool batt, 89 mm (3.5 in), 15.25 x 47 in, 59.7 ft2 per pack
supplier: ROCKWOOL Comfortbatt R15 via Home Depot or Lowe's
notes: Three side layers, two in the headspace, two over the lid, and the base fill. Binder burns off on first heat.

spec: K-23 insulating firebrick, 230 x 114 x 64 mm
notes: Stood on edge under the chime. Bearing stress 0.55 MPa against about 1 MPa crushing strength.

spec: Aluminum roll flashing, 20 in x 25 ft
notes: Side wrap in two rows plus the top cap. Runs at 26 C, so aluminum is acceptable here.

spec: Aluminum foil tape and sheet metal screws
notes: Tape also seals the pipe ends for standby tests.

spec: ESP32 development board (ESP32-WROOM-32)
notes: Charge control on the well-wall thermocouple and 10 s logging over Wi-Fi.

spec: MAX6675 module with K probe, pack of five
notes: Five channels: well wall, sand center, sand near the drum wall, U-tube outlet air and room air. The two kit probes serve the air channels (400 C or below).

spec: Type K, mineral insulated, 3 mm 310 or 304 stainless sheath, 500 mm, 1 m lead
supplier: Amazon (or Omega or Auber for tighter tolerance)
notes: Well wall (control), well wall (limit), sand center, sand near the drum wall.

spec: Zero-cross SSR, 25 A, 24 to 380 VAC load, 3 to 32 VDC control
notes: Switches all four heaters. A shorted SSR is covered by the latching relay.

spec: Aluminum SSR heat sink with thermal pad
notes: About 10 W dissipation at 8.3 A.

spec: REX-C100 temperature controller, relay output (R*AN), type K input, 120 VAC supply
notes: Set as an on-off permissive that opens at 600 C well-wall temperature. Wired into the latching relay coil circuit.

spec: Power relay, DPDT, 30 A per pole, 120 VAC coil, with socket (JQX-30F 2Z class)
notes: K1 on TBK-DWG-003. Pole 1 switches the heaters; pole 2 is the holding contact that latches it after START.

spec: Momentary pushbuttons, one normally open (START) and one normally closed (STOP), 22 mm
notes: Any limit trip or power loss drops the relay until START is pressed.

spec: Steel electrical enclosure, about 200 x 150 x 100 mm, with DIN rail
Inline fuse holder with 10 A fast-acting fuse
supplier: Home Depot or auto parts store
notes: Protects the heater leads.

spec: 14/3 SJT cord with NEMA 5-15 plug, 6 ft
notes: Plugs into a GFCI-protected 15 A or 20 A garage receptacle; 8.3 A load.

spec: Resistor, 10 kOhm, 1/4 W, 5 %
supplier: DigiKey or an assortment on hand
notes: R1 and R2 on TBK-DWG-003: hold the SSR and blower off through ESP32 boot and reset.

spec: Steel handy box with a ceramic terminal block
